headline: Sanchez, bullpen blank Orioles as Phillies bounce back
recap: Cristopher Sanchez struck out 11 over six shutout innings and the Phillies broke a scoreless game with a run in the fifth before putting it away with a four-run eighth, beating the Orioles 5-0 at Camden Yards. Brandon Marsh and Trea Turner each had two hits, Justin Crawford drove in two runs, and Bryce Harper added a double, a walk and a run scored. Jose Alvarado, Jhoan Duran and Jonathan Bowlan combined for three scoreless innings out of the bullpen to finish the shutout.

The win moved Philadelphia to 58-53, good for second place in the NL East, 8.0 games behind the division-leading Braves and 1.5 games ahead of third-place Miami. The Phillies have won their last game after dropping four in a row.

Philadelphia closes out the series in Baltimore this afternoon, with Zack Wheeler facing Orioles right-hander Kyle Bradish. First pitch is scheduled for 1:35 PM ET, and DraftKings has the Phillies as -149 moneyline favorites. The team then heads home to open a three-game series against the Nationals on Monday.
